read whole novels and watch whole movies

our_interpretation: The plain reading is a prediction about the limits of the specified architectures, without a deadline.

Passing means reliably answering substantive, open-ended questions about complete narratives, including motivations, conflicts and humor, at a level ordinary competent human readers or viewers would recognize as comprehension.
A fair implementation should use held-out material, independently assessed answers and a stated passing standard. These are evaluation requirements, not numerical thresholds Marcus supplied.
The architecture restriction defines eligible systems; it is not a separate conditional antecedent.
The reference to GPT-10 illustrates scaling without architectural changes. It does not establish a calendar deadline.
criteria.support_condition: A decisive demonstration that the specified architecture class cannot pass a fair implementation of the challenge would support the unrestricted forecast. Failures by particular systems provide limited evidence but cannot establish permanent failure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A reproducible pass on a fair implementation by a system documented to use only the permitted architectures, without writable latent discrete memory or other excluded mechanisms.

evidence.explanation: Marcus adopts this definition in the post. It establishes the architectural scope, not whether the prediction succeeded.

SagaScale reports meaningful progress on questions about full-length novels, which weighs against assuming such comprehension cannot improve through neural models. Stable performance across lengths does not establish a pass on Marcus's broader challenge or verify the architectural restriction.

evidence.excerpt: a substantial gap relative to human performance.
evidence.explanation: Movie Facts and Fibs tests narrative comprehension using paired true and false claims about movies. The reported gap documents limitations on a related task, but neither its format nor failures by these systems establish permanent failure on the Comprehension Challenge.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A reproducible, independently assessed pass on a fair implementation, accompanied by documentation showing that the system meets the architecture restriction, would contradict the forecast. A decisive impossibility result covering that architecture class would support it.
